principles: The QNL spreadsheet is an institutional policy overlay, not the boundary of the registry.
Strong identifiers reconcile before names: PUID, LOC FDD ID, NARA ID, MIME type, then name and extension.
Authoritative external hazard and QNL criteria hazard are estimators of intrinsic hazard. They are reconciled, not added.
Readiness, exposure, trend, confidence, and provenance remain separate axes.

critical_alert_rule.description: Critical is an operational alert, not a base hazard band.
critical_alert_rule.logic: High hazard plus any two of: high exposure, weak/no readiness, negative trend.
